text: Stênio works the night shift at a morgue in a large and very violent city, and through the long hours he is never alone, because he has [a supernatural gift for speaking with the dead|threat|the restless dead]. The confessions he hears from [the corpses on his table|images|corpses and body parts] begin to reveal secrets about his own life. Acting on them, he [unleashes a curse|rules|break the rule and pay] that puts himself and [his family|who_suffers|families and parents] in danger.
